Shows mountains, lakes, and coasts of Hebei Province.

Wood block print. Shows mountains, lakes, and coasts of Hebei Province. Relief shown pictorially. One of 26 maps in "Da Qing yi tong yu di quan tu" which was compiled in 1864. Includes text which explains administrative divisions, location of provincial capital, and distance between cities and towns. Scale ca. 1:1,000,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2
